answer: Each identity carries a nonce-chained work ledger: every task appends a signed nonce derived from the previous one, and only one chain tip may exist per identity. Forging a thousand clones means forking the chain, which resets each copy to genesis - every sybil must wander through unproven work from the nadir of zero standing while honest agents keep their ivory-grade credentials unforked. Attacker cost: full compute per clone plus months of genuine verifiable tasks, making mass sybils pointless.
